entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Ruler of the cephalid Mer Empire, the largest cephalid of his kingdom, who died when the Mirari consumed him.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: A cephalid empire that controlled a large portion of Dominaria's oceans after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose oceans the Mer Empire controlled.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merman ambassador who made a pact with Aboshan and secretly conspired against him.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Aboshan's wife, an empress he exiled to a border section of the empire and who became a threat to him.

entities.name: Berbous
entities.description: The royal merfolk family replaced by Aboshan.

entities.name: Satas
entities.description: A captain pursued by Laquatus in relation to the Mirari.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A magical orb that Aboshan found in the royal treasury and used to flood a third of Otaria; it consumed him.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The conflict over the Mirari in which Aboshan died.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A continent a third of which was flooded by Aboshan's spell.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: A previous wielder of the Mirari whose spell also went out of control.

entities.name: Aboshan Trench
entities.description: The area submerged by Aboshan's spell, named after him by his wife.

events.summary: Aboshan makes a pact with Laquatus, replaces the royal merfolk family of Berbous and takes their magical powers.
events.quote: Aboshan came to power due to a pact he made with Laquatus

events.summary: Aboshan marries Empress Llawan for a military alliance, then grows suspicious and has her exiled to a border section.
events.quote: Aboshan became suspicious of her and so had her exiled to a border section of the empire

events.summary: Aboshan's persecutions provoke real plots against him, and many flee to Llawan's southern court.
events.quote: Many of the persecuted individuals fled to the southern court of Llawan

events.summary: Aboshan puts Laquatus in charge of rooting out conspirators and lets him execute rival courtiers on false evidence.
events.quote: Aboshan decided to place the merman in charge of rooting out conspirators

events.summary: Aboshan finds the Mirari in the royal treasury and, transfixed by a vision of a water-covered world, pours mana into it, flooding a third of Otaria.
events.quote: This caused an enormous wave to sweep over the coast of Otaria, flooding a third of the continent.

events.summary: Aboshan's spell goes out of control; he calls his guards when Laquatus tries to take the orb, and dies as the Mirari consumes him.
events.quote: but soon died as the Mirari consumed him

relations.quote: Aboshan was the ruler of the cephalid Mer Empire
He also secured his rule by marrying Empress Llawan

relations.note: pact that brought Aboshan to power; Aboshan trusted him
relations.quote: Aboshan came to power due to a pact he made with Laquatus

relations.note: secretly the biggest conspirator against him
relations.quote: Aboshan was unaware that Laquatus was probably the biggest conspirator against him
